prompt: A JComboBox filters a JList of produce by kind. Complete applyFilter so it rebuilds the list model from the fixed ITEMS array and updates a count label like "3 of 6 shown".
explanation: The fixed ITEMS array is the source of truth and the DefaultListModel is only a view of it, so every filter run clears the model and rebuilds it rather than trying to delete individual rows. Comparing with "All".equals(chosen) rather than chosen.equals("All") keeps the code safe even if nothing is selected and getSelectedItem returns null. Rebuilding in the order of ITEMS is what keeps the display order stable no matter which category is picked.
hints: category.getSelectedItem() returns Object, so cast it to String before comparing.
Call shown.clear() first, then loop over ITEMS and addElement the names that match.
The count label needs shown.getSize() after the loop and ITEMS.length for the total.
